source_identity: Exact workspace hashes below; root owns the subsequent commit.
independently_verified: Search uses the sanctioned observed clone and horizon without accessing private/source task fields; static source has no image loader, optimizer, or reference-label logic.

Every cap from zero through seven is checked on a six-edge analytic tree. Completed search enumerates all legal edges, never the masked edge, and reaches OPEN(-4), CONTINUE(-1), TAKE(+12), cumulative return +7.

Extreme STOP/forbidden logits and critic values of opposite signs do not replace physical cumulative reward or remove legal inventory; actor calls match recorded forwards, parameter state is unchanged, and critic perturbation leaves guided traces identical.
Call counts and completed-layer sums reconcile; incumbents are monotonic across increased caps under fixed ordering; negative prefixes remain available and beam pruning is separately reported.
An expensive last transition raises a time-limit failure with the completed work and best prefix retained rather than returning a within-budget result.
Successful and interrupted model-state mutation both reject a frozen-plan claim. Interrupted forward attempts and finite evaluated transition prefixes have distinct accounting.

Patient-uniform BC indices feed the existing imitation loss with derivative +1/3 in an analytic six-patient control; pooled-state weighting would produce the opposite sign when one teacher has 1000 states. Backpropagation checks the derivative; weights do not change.
owner_checks_rerun: Original metadata bytes, all six TRAIN/two SELECT roles, canonical group identities, preoperative visits, full cohort membership, and duplicate detection.
PAT29/31, SELECT-as-TRAIN, and external identities rejected before case loading; only the metadata manifest was read.
Patient-uniform draws preserve STOP-only teachers, reject missing/empty patients, and shuffle every TRAIN patient once per round.
On-policy batch records require complete finite trajectories from TRAIN and a common canonical behavior hash; stale or mixed hashes fail.

Incremental beam retention matches full-materialization oracle across 430 cap-by-width combinations, including complete enumeration; direct live-instance counters verify bounded state retention and release.

preserved_failures.summary: Mutating interrupted forward was rejected but omitted actor_forward_calls from partial accounting.
Charging attempted transitions also counted a failed transition as an evaluated STOP prefix (2 versus 1).

limits: These are software checks, not medical accuracy, efficacy, latency, or generalization results.
Observed-only semantics and native legal-action certification remain the supplied task's responsibility; this helper checks the declared planning-model flag.
A full nominal planner field and cropped actor input are different representations. A prospective comparison must report this difference.
The batch helper validates supplied behavior hashes; actual rollout code must measure policy state before and after collection.
The frozen search guard covers parameters and registered buffers, not arbitrary mutable Python counters.
Beam/call truncation can miss a better opening route. A returned STOP incumbent does not prove STOP is optimal.
